assertionSteps.title: 1. Given User A is an entitled fixture user in an isolated browser context with empty browser storage
2. And the LOCAL login page is visible; the credential service accepts user-a / FixturePass1!; directory fullName is absent; the BFF fallback returns fullName="user-a"
3. When User A enters "user-a" into the textbox with placeholder "Enter Username" on the login page
4. And User A enters "FixturePass1!" into the text input with placeholder "Enter Password" on the login page
5. And User A clicks the button labelled "Sign In" on the login page
6. Then the tab labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is visible

steps.title: One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".

assertionSteps.title: 7. When User A clicks the icon button with test ID "${MFE_APP_PREFIX_STYLE}_avatar_IconButton" in the portal header on the Home page
8. And User A clicks the menu item containing "user-a" inside the menu with DOM ID "menu-appbar-avatar"
9. Then the text "user-a" is visible inside the dialog titled "User Profile" on the Home page
